stem: Under position-based attribution with 40% to the first touch, 40% to the last and 20% to the touches in between, how should an order with exactly two touches be credited?

options.text: Half to each touch, so the whole order is credited
40% to each touch, and the other 20% to no channel
40% to each touch, and 20% to the unattributed row
60% to the first touch and 40% to the last touch
